summary.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
summary.description: Experienced Software Test Engineer with expertise in mobile app testing, CI/CD management, backend services, end-to-end testing, contract testing, and agile quality practices.

Dedicated time to intensive self-study to improve German language proficiency.
Currently actively seeking a long-term Senior Software Engineering opportunity.

Managed mobile app release and testing processes
